title: Capture YouTube transcripts from the cloud: YouTube blocks our Lambda addresses
description: Measured 2026-11-04: in the last 30 days the router's YouTube capture was blocked 39 times and worked once. The same call from a home connection returned 30,151 characters for UytYrhYLOKI. Ryan: this must be a cloud function and cannot depend on any Mac being connected. An editor's paste in the To capture queue stays the fallback only.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan, 2026-11-04: no paying for YouTube transcripts, and it must not depend on a Mac being on. Paid vendors and proxies are out.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan, 2026-11-04: remove the Lambda's YouTube transcript attempt, since it is expected to fail. Build a worker CLI, run by anyone signed in on a home connection, that finds videos with no captured content through indexes, never a scan. If no index finds items without captured content quickly, add one.
